import MumfordLib.SimplicialCohomologyPair

/-!
# Biproduct form of cohomology Mayer--Vietoris

The cochain Mayer--Vietoris producer is initially expressed using the homology
of a degreewise product complex.  This file transports it across the canonical
homology biproduct isomorphism, exposing the usual three-term sequence
`H^n(A ∪ B) → H^n(A) ⊞ H^n(B) → H^n(A ∩ B)`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex)

/-- The Mayer--Vietoris short complex with the middle term written as a
cohomology biproduct. -/
def simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod (n : ℕ) :
    ShortComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) :=
  ShortComplex.mk
    (homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n ≫
      (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).hom)
    ((integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).inv ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      exact integralSimplicialCohomologyUnionRestriction_intersectionDifference A B n)

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod_f (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod A B n).f =
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n ≫
        (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).hom := rfl

@[simp]
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod_g (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod A B n).g =
      (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).inv ≫
        homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n := rfl

/-- Exactness is preserved by replacing the product-complex middle term by the
canonical biproduct of the two subcomplex cohomologies. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod_exact (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod A B n).Exact := by
  let S := (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).map
    (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)
  let e : simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod A B n ≅ S :=
    ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl _)
      (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).symm
      (Iso.refl _) (by
        dsimp [S, simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod]
        change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n =
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n ≫
            (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso
              (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).hom ≫
              (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso
                (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).inv
        simp) (by
        dsimp [S, simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisBiprod]
        change (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso
            (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).inv ≫
            homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n =
          (integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso
            (K := (A : SSet)) (L := (B : SSet)) n).inv ≫
            homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n
        simp)
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso e).mpr
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_pair A B n)

end Mumford.Analytic
